title: European Research and Innovation Days 2026: Day 1 (Auditorium)
summary: Full stream of the opening day in the Auditorium of the Commission's flagship research and innovation event, held in Brussels and online.
body: The European Research and Innovation Days are the European Commission's flagship event on research and innovation policy. The 2026 edition, the seventh, runs on 10 and 11 November in Brussels and online, organised by the Directorate-General for Research and Innovation.

This stream covers the first day of sessions in the Auditorium, including the opening of the event. Policymakers, researchers, innovators, business leaders and civil society discuss how research and innovation can strengthen Europe's competitiveness, resilience and technological sovereignty.
why: Ullswater Investments note: the opening day is where the Commission frames its research and innovation priorities for the year ahead. Watching it helps companies and consortia understand the policy direction behind future Horizon Europe calls and the next framework programme.
